blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Different MRI modalities reveal different parts of a brain tumor. Segmentation models combine information from these modalities to outline tumor regions. Many models use a separate encoder for each modality. However, exchanging features among these encoders at several stages can increase model complexity. We introduce the Block-Wise Shared Adapter (BWSA), which combines compressed features from the modality encoders in a shared path and returns adapted features to each stream. In its fixed-blending form, BWSA adds the adapted features to the original features. Its trainable-gated variant (TG-BWSA) instead learns separate weights for the original and adapted features at each modality and encoder stage. We evaluate both variants on BraTS 2020 and BraTS 2023 with four segmentation backbones. On the official BraTS 2023 online validation set, BWSA increases average region-wise Dice by 1.3--7.6 percentage points relative to the corresponding unmodified backbones. TG-BWSA increases it by 2.8--7.7 points. Both variants add approximately 0.85--3.73% parameters and reduce average HD95 relative to the unmodified backbones.
blocks.zh: 不同的核磁共振模式揭示出脑瘤的不同部分. 分解模型结合了这些模式的信息来勾勒出肿瘤区域. 许多模型对每种模式使用单独的编码器. 然而,这些编码器在几个阶段之间交换特性可以增加模型的复杂性. 我们引入了 Block-Wise 共享适配器(BWSA),它将模式编码器的压缩特性结合在一个共享路径中,并返回每个流所适应的特性. BWSA在其固定的混合形式下,将被改造的特征添加到原始特征上. 其可被训练的变体(TG-BWSA)取而代之的是,在每种模式和编码器阶段,为原始和被改造的特性分别学习权重. 我们在BratS 2020和BratS 2023上评价两个变体,都有四个分块骨干. 在官方的 BratS 2023 在线验证集上,BWSA 相对于相应的未修改主干线,平均区域Dice增加了1.3-7.6个百分点. blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Brain tumor segmentation from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) supports diagnosis, treatment planning, and longitudinal assessment [ 1 ] . Multimodal protocols commonly include contrast-enhanced T1-weighted (T1ce), T1-weighted (T1), fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR), and T2-weighted (T2) images, which provide complementary information about tumor and surrounding tissue [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 来自磁共振成像(MRI)的脑瘤分化支持诊断,治疗规划和纵向评估[1]. 多式联运协议通常包括对比增强的T1-加权(T1ce),T1-加权(T1),流体增强反转恢复(FLAIR),以及T2-加权(T2)图像,这些图像提供了肿瘤和周围组织的补充信息[2].

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Representative fusion placements. (a) Early fusion concatenates the modalities at the input. (b) Late fusion combines independently produced predictions. (c) BWSA inserts a shared adaptation path between encoder stages. Its gated extension learns scalar weights for the original and adapted streams of each modality at each stage.
blocks.zh: 费格。 1: 代表性聚变布局. (a) 早期聚变在输入时使模式凝聚。 (b) 晚聚变结合了独立产生的预测。 (c) BWSA在编码器阶段之间插入一个共享的适应路径。 它的门形扩展学习每个阶段每种模式的原始流和适应流的分量。

blocks.en: Fusion strategies are commonly classified by where they combine the modalities [ 3 ] . Early fusion concatenates modalities at the input, whereas late fusion merges independently produced outputs. Early fusion allows interaction throughout the network but does not preserve separate modality streams. Late fusion preserves those streams but postpones their interaction until the output. Intermediate fusion combines encoder features at one or more depths. Methods that use attention or gates can model cross-modal dependencies at these depths, but modality-specific branches and dense attention can increase parameter and computational costs [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 融合战略通常按其结合方式[3]的地方分类. 早期聚变在输入时会集成模式,而晚聚变则会独立产生产出. 早期聚变可以在整个网络中进行交互,但不保留单独的模式流. 晚聚变保存了这些流,但将其相互作用推迟到输出. 中间聚变结合了一个或多个深度的编码器特征. 使用注意或关卡的方法可以模拟这些深度的跨模式依赖,但模式特定的分支和密集的注意可以增加参数和计算成本[4,5,6].

blocks.en: Adapters have also been used in intermediate fusion. Shi et al. place fusion adapters at multiple layers of two pretrained Segment Anything Model (SAM) encoders to combine two MRI modality groups for glioma segmentation [ 7 ] . Lu et al. use a dual-stream adapter to align modality features before fusing them at multiple scales [ 8 ] . We test whether a shared adapter can exchange features among four MRI encoders with a small increase in parameters. We also compare fixed and learned weights for combining the original and adapted features.
blocks.zh: 适配器也被用于中间聚变. 许等. 将聚变适配器放置在两个预加训练的区段 Anything Model (SAM) 编码器的多层上,以便结合两个核磁共振模式组进行胶原分裂[7]. 吕等. 使用双流适配器,在多尺度的引信之前调整模式特性[8]。 我们测试一个共享适配器是否能够在四个核磁共振编码器之间以小幅增加参数交换特性. 我们还比较了固定和学习的权重,以综合原有和改造的特征。

blocks.en: We evaluate BWSA with fixed and learned stream weights on BraTS 2020 and BraTS 2023 using four CNN, Transformer, and hybrid backbones. We report local validation results and results from the BraTS 2023 online validation server. On online validation, fixed-weight BWSA raises average Dice by 1.3–7.6 percentage points relative to the unmodified backbones. The gated extension raises it by 2.8–7.7 percentage points. Both forms have nearly the same number of parameters because the gates add only two scalar weights per modality and stage. The reported overhead of 0.85–3.73% compares the gated adapter with each unmodified backbone. We also evaluate RFNet [ 9 ] with both forms of BWSA under 14 incomplete input configurations and report the complete input result separately.

blocks.en: Contributions. The main contributions of this work are: • We introduce BWSA, a stage-wise shared adapter that can be inserted between encoder blocks in the four evaluated backbones. • We extend BWSA to TG-BWSA by learning two scalar weights per modality and stage for the adapted multimodal stream and the original stream. The shared adapter path remains unchanged. • We evaluate the shared adapter with fixed and learned weights. We also compare it with separate adapters for each modality. • Missing modality experiments cover all 14 incomplete input configurations and report the complete input case separately.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Multimodal Fusion Methods
blocks.zh: II-A 多式联运组合方法

blocks.en: Some models combine MRI sequences before feature extraction. Swin UNETR takes the four sequences as channels of one input and learns a joint representation [ 10 ] . This gives the encoder access to all sequences from its first layer, but does not keep a separate stream for each one. To retain modality-specific features, Nie et al. encode each modality separately and merge their high-level features before segmentation [ 11 ] . Fang et al. also use separate modality inputs and combine their features through hybrid attention, together with self-supervised feature learning [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 一些模型在特征提取前结合了核磁共振序列. Swin UNETR将四个序列作为一个输入的渠道,并学习联合代表[10]. 这使得编码器可以访问其第一层的所有序列,但并没有为每个序列保留单独的流. 为保留特定模式的特点,Nie等人, 将每种模式分别编码,并在分割前合并其高层次特征[11]. 方 al等. 还使用单独的模式输入,并通过混合关注结合其特征,加上自我监督的特征学习[12].

blocks.en: With separate streams, fusion can use learned interactions between their features. NestedFormer uses attention to combine high-level modality features and gating at lower scales [ 4 ] . mmFormer uses an inter-modal Transformer to relate features from modality-specific encoders [ 5 ] . F2Net maintains both modality-specific and shared representations, with modules that exchange information between them [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 以单独的溪流,聚变可以使用其特征之间的学到的相互作用. 嵌入 前者使用注意力来结合高层次模式特征和在较低尺度的配角[4]. 毫米 前者使用一种模式间变换器来连接特定模式编码器的特性[5]. F2Net保持特定模式和共享的表示方式,各模块之间交流信息[6]。

blocks.en: II-B Modality Weighting and Missing Inputs
blocks.zh: II-B 加权和输入缺失

blocks.en: Keeping the modalities separate also allows a model to vary their contributions. RFNet learns which modality features matter in different tumor regions [ 9 ] . A2FSeg averages the available features and then uses attention to adjust their fusion [ 13 ] . These methods derive their weights from the input features. TG-BWSA instead learns one pair of stream weights for each modality and stage; the weights stay fixed across test inputs.
blocks.zh: 将模式分开还允许一种模式改变它们的贡献。 RFNet了解哪种模式在不同肿瘤区域具有重要性[9]. 页:1 FSeg平均现有特性,然后用注意力来调整它们的聚变[13]. 这些方法的权重来源于输入特性. TG-BWSA转而为每种模式和阶段学习一对溪流重量;重量在测试输入之间保持不变。

blocks.en: When a sequence is missing, the set of features available for fusion changes. HeMIS handles different subsets by averaging the embeddings of the available modalities [ 14 ] . Chen et al. combine feature disentanglement and gated fusion to learn from incomplete inputs [ 15 ] . Qiu et al. show that adding a modality can harm predictions in some regions and calibrate the fusion result accordingly [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 当一个序列缺失时,可用于核聚变的一组特性会发生变化. HIMIS通过平均现有模式的嵌入处理不同的子集[14]. 陈等. 结合特征分解和门式聚变,学习不完全输入[15]. 邱等编. 表明添加一种模式会损害某些地区的预测,并相应校准聚变结果[16].

blocks.en: II-C Adapters for Multimodal Fusion
blocks.zh: II-C 多式联运组合适应器

blocks.en: Adapters add a small trainable path to a model. Med-SA uses them to adapt pretrained SAM to medical image segmentation [ 17 ] . Adapters can also take part in fusion. Shi et al. use fusion adapters between two pretrained SAM encoders to combine MRI modality groups at multiple layers [ 7 ] . Lu et al. use a dual-stream adapter to align modality features before multi-scale fusion [ 8 ] . BWSA connects four separate modality streams through one shared adapter path at each encoder stage.
blocks.zh: 适配器在模型中添加一个小的可列车路径. Med-SA使用它们来适应预先训练的SAM来进行医学影像分解[17]. 适配器也可以参与聚变. 许等. 使用两个预先训练的SAM编码器之间的聚变适配器,在多层结合核磁共振模式组[7]. 吕等. 使用双流适配器,在多规模聚变前对齐模式特性[8]. BWSA在每个编码器阶段通过一个共享适配器路径连接四个独立的模式流.

blocks.en: III Block-Wise Shared Adapter Framework
blocks.zh: 三. 街区-智慧共享适应器框架

blocks.en: BWSA uses a shared path between encoder blocks to process compressed features from all modalities. It adds the adapted feature to the original feature of each modality. Its gated extension, TG-BWSA, learns separate nonnegative scalar weights for the original and adapted features at each modality and stage.
blocks.zh: BWSA使用编码器块之间的共享路径处理所有模式的压缩特性. 它在每种模式的原始特征中增加了经过调整的特征. 它的门形扩展,TG-BWSA,在每种模式和阶段,为原始和适应的特性,学习单独的非负式卡路里加权.

blocks.en: We use scalar gates to limit the number of added parameters. Channel-wise or spatial gates would provide finer control, but CMCR already weights channels in the combined features. Each learned gate applies to one modality and stage and remains fixed across test inputs. One shared path processes features from all modalities. Separate paths would repeat the same operations without combining their features inside the adapter. We compare the shared and separate paths in the PMA ablation under a similar parameter budget.

blocks.en: IV Experimental Setup and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 四. 实验设置和评价

blocks.en: IV-A Datasets and Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 数据集和评价计量

blocks.en: We conduct experiments on the BraTS 2020 (369 subjects) and BraTS 2023 (1,251 subjects) datasets [ 19 , 20 , 2 , 21 ] . Each dataset contains co-registered T1ce, T1, FLAIR, and T2 volumes with voxel-wise tumor annotations. We randomly assign 80% of the subjects to training and 20% to local validation. For BraTS 2023, we also report results on the official online validation set of 219 subjects. Dice is reported for all experiments. The local-validation Dice scores for 2D models are calculated on axial slices rather than reconstructed volumes and are not directly comparable with 3D local-validation or official online Dice scores. HD95 is also reported for the BraTS 2023 online validation set.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了BratS 2020(369个学科)和BratS 2023(1 251个学科)数据集的实验[19,20,2,21]. 每个数据集包含共同注册的T1ce,T1,FLAIR,以及带有阴性肿瘤说明的T2卷. 我们随机将80%的科目分配给培训,20%分配给当地验证。 对于BRATS 2023,我们也报告219个学科的官方在线验证集的结果. 所有实验都报告有虱子。 2D模型的本地验证Dice分数是在轴切片上计算,而不是重建体积,与3D本地验证或官方在线Dice分数没有直接可比性. HD95也被报道为BratS 2023在线验证集.

blocks.en: BraTS online evaluation metrics: We report region-wise (voxel-wise) Dice and HD95 for ET, TC, and WT. Lesion-wise results from the same online submission are reported in Table IX .
blocks.zh: BRATS在线评价衡量标准: 我们从区域角度(从voxel角度)报告ET、TC和WT的Dice和HD95。 同一在线提交的结果见表九。

blocks.en: Data split and reproducibility: All train/validation splits are performed at the subject level to prevent slice-level leakage. For each dataset, we randomly split subjects into 80% training and 20% validation once and keep this split fixed for all methods. Local-validation results are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation over three independent runs with different random seeds for weight initialization and data order. Each run uses the same split and checkpoint-selection rule.
blocks.zh: 数据分割和可复制性: 所有列车/验证分拆均在主体一级进行,以防止切片级泄漏. 对于每个数据集,我们随机地将课题分为80%的培训和20%的验证一次,并保持这一分割对所有方法的固定. 当地验证结果报告为平均±\pm标准偏差,高于三个独立运行,并有不同的随机种子进行重量初始化和数据顺序. 每次跑步都采用相同的拆分规则和检查站选择规则.

blocks.zh: 四-B 执行详情

blocks.en: Backbone Architectures: We integrated BWSA with fixed weights and with trainable gates into two 3D backbones, RFNet [ 9 ] and mmFormer [ 5 ] , and two 2D backbones, a Multi-Encoder U-Net (MEUNet), implemented by us for this study, and Multi-Encoder FCT (MEFCT) [ 22 ] . F2Net [ 6 ] uses Cross-modal Feature-enhanced Modules and Multimodal Collaboration Modules at multiple stages. We ran the authors’ F2Net code and calculated Dice for its predictions using the same Dice calculation as for our 2D models. For the adapter comparisons, we retained the decoder and loss function of each backbone.
blocks.zh: 后骨结构 : 我们用固定重量和可训练门将BWSA整合为两个3D主干线,RFNet[9]和mmFormer[5],以及两个2D主干线,即我们为本研究实施的多编码U-Net(MEUNet)和多编码FCT(MEFCT)[22]. F2Net[6]在多个阶段使用跨模式增强功能模块和多模式协作模块. 我们运行了作者的F2Net代码,并用与我们的2D模型相同的Dice计算法计算了Dice的预测. 对于适配器的比较,我们保留了每个主干线的解码器和损失功能.

blocks.en: Training Scenarios: We evaluated two training scenarios. RFNet, mmFormer, and MEUNet were trained from scratch. In the second scenario, the MEFCT encoders were initialized with self-supervised weights from RePre [ 23 ] . The encoder freezing protocol for pretrained MEFCT, used by TG-BWSA, BWSA, and LoRA [ 24 ] variants, is described below.

blocks.en: Partial fine-tuning of pretrained MEFCT encoders: We use a two-phase partial fine-tuning protocol for the pretrained MEFCT encoders. In Phase 1, all encoder layers are frozen. The decoder is trained for every variant, together with the BWSA, TG-BWSA, or LoRA modules when present. In Phase 2, the encoder bottleneck blocks are also unfrozen while the earlier encoder layers remain fixed. This protocol applies to the MEFCT variants in Table VII and those marked with † in the BraTS 2023 online validation table. Augmentations, losses, optimizer, scheduler, early stopping, and evaluation are held constant across the adapter variants.

blocks.en: IV-C 2 Region-wise Online Validation

blocks.en: BraTS 2023 online validation protocol: For each model, we trained three runs on the same 80% subject-level training split. We selected the run with the highest mean Dice on the held-out 20% local validation split and submitted predictions from that run to the official BraTS 2023 online validation server. Neither local nor online validation subjects were used for training.
blocks.zh: BrATS 2023在线验证协议: 对每个模式,我们训练了3次 相同的80%的科目级培训。 我们选择了以最高平均值的Dice在被搁置的20%本地验证分拆的运行,并提交了从该运行到官方BratS 2023在线验证服务器的预测. 当地或在线验证科目都没有用于培训。

blocks.en: On the official BraTS 2023 online validation set (Table VIII ), RFNet has an average Dice of 0.8314 without an adapter. BWSA raises it to 0.8639, and learning the weights raises it to 0.8654. The corresponding average HD95 values are 28.80, 14.37, and 16.34 mm. Thus, fixed weights give RFNet a lower average HD95 than learned weights. With mmFormer, MEUNet, and MEFCT, the gated form increases average Dice over the unmodified backbone by 0.0769, 0.0283, and 0.0450, respectively. It also reduces average HD95 for these three backbones. The added effect of learned weights varies by region and backbone.
blocks.zh: 在官方的BRATS 2023在线验证集(表八)上,RFNet没有适配器的平均剂量为0.8314. BWSA将其提升至0.8639,学习重量提升至0.8654. 相应的HD95平均值为28.80,14.37,16.34毫米. 因此,固定加权给RFNet的平均HD95比学到的加权要低. 与mmFormer,MEUNet,以及MEFCT一起,门形比未修改的骨干平均增加Dice,分别为0.0769,0.0283和0.0450. 这也降低了这三个骨干的平均HD95. 学习权重的附加效应因区域和骨干而异.

blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: BWSA increases mean Dice over the unmodified model across the four evaluated backbones in local and online validation. Learning the weights does not improve every metric. On BraTS 2023 online validation, the gated form has higher average Dice on all four backbones, but fixed weights give RFNet a lower average HD95 (14.37 vs. 16.34 mm; Table VIII ). Under incomplete RFNet inputs, fixed weights give higher mean TC Dice, whereas learned weights give higher WT and ET Dice (Table XIV ). For MEUNet, learning the weights raises average online Dice from 0.8303 to 0.8460. Both forms of BWSA improved average Dice and HD95 over the unmodified backbones on BraTS 2023 online validation. Their parameter counts are nearly identical. For a given backbone, the choice between fixed blending and learned weights should be guided by validation performance on the metric of interest.
blocks.zh: BWSA在本地和在线验证的4个评价骨干中,比未经修改的模型增加平均Dice。 学习权重并不能提高每个度量。 在BRATS 2023在线验证中,门形在所有四个骨干上的平均剂量都较高,但固定的权重给予RFNet较低的平均HD95(14.37对16.34毫米;表八. 在不完全的RFNet投入下,固定权重给予较高的平均TC Dice,而学到的权重给予较高的WT和ET Dice(表十四)。 对于MEUNet来说,学习权重将在线平均Dice从0.8303提高到0.8460. BWSA的两种形式都比BratS 2023在线验证上的未修改主干线改善了平均Dice和HD95. 他们的参数数几乎相同. 对某一骨干而言,固定混合和学习权重之间的选择应当以利益度量的验证性能为指导。

blocks.en: The gate coefficients are fixed after training and cannot adjust to the reliability of an individual test image. Their trajectories do not explain the observed differences between tumor regions. In the RFNet ablation, TG-BWSA has higher mean Dice than PMA with a similar parameter count (0.8982 vs. 0.8947; Table XII ). blocks.en: For the lesion-wise online metrics, RFNet+TG-BWSA has higher average Dice (0.852 vs. 0.848) and lower average HD95 (20.61 vs. 23.40 mm) than RFNet+BWSA (Table IX ). Its average lesion-wise Dice remains below the three highest-scoring teams listed in that table (0.876–0.888). The compared submissions use different training and inference pipelines, so these scores provide benchmark context rather than an isolated comparison of architectures.

blocks.en: Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: The evaluation uses BraTS 2020 and BraTS 2023 without an external cohort. Each online score comes from one of three runs selected by local validation Dice, so variation in online scores across seeds was not measured. Missing modalities are simulated by zeroing complete input volumes, and modality dropout is not used during training. The LoRA comparison differs in parameter count and module placement, so it does not measure efficiency per parameter. Future studies can test scanner and protocol shifts, partial image corruption, and modality dropout during training.
blocks.zh: 该评价使用BratS 2020和BratS 2023,没有外部组别. 每个在线得分来自当地验证Dice所选择的3个运行之一,因此没有测量跨种子的在线得分差异. 缺失模式通过零化完整的输入量模拟,在培训期间不使用退出模式。 LoRA比较在参数计数和模块布置上有所不同,因此不测量每个参数的效率. 未来的研究可以测试扫描仪和协议的转变,部分图像腐败,以及培训期间的方式辍学。

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: BWSA lets separate modality encoders combine features through one shared adapter between stages. With fixed weights, it adds the adapted features to the original features. TG-BWSA extends the same adapter by learning those weights for each modality and stage. We evaluated both forms with four backbones on BraTS 2020 and BraTS 2023. On the official BraTS 2023 online validation set, BWSA increased average region-wise Dice by 1.3–7.6 percentage points relative to the unmodified backbones. The gated extension increased it by 2.8–7.7 points. Both forms increased parameter counts by approximately 0.85–3.73% relative to the unmodified backbones. Both forms reduced average HD95 relative to the corresponding unmodified backbones. The choice between fixed blending and learned weights should be guided by validation results for the chosen backbone and evaluation metric.
blocks.zh: BWSA允许单独的模式编码器通过一个不同阶段之间的共享适配器来组合特性. 有了固定的权重,它又在原有的功能中加入了经过改造的特征. TG-BWSA通过学习每种方式和阶段的权重来扩展同一个适配器. 我们在BRATS 2020和BRATS 2023上用四个骨干评价了这两种表格. 在官方的BratS 2023在线验证集上,BWSA比未修改的主干线提高了1.3–7.6个百分点,平均区域Dice. 闸口延长线增加了2.8–7.7分. 与未经修改的骨干相比,这两种形式都增加了大约0.85-3.73%的参数。 两种形式都相对相应的未修改骨干降低了平均HD95. 固定的混合和学习的权重之间的选择应当以选定骨干和评价尺度的验证结果为指导。
